title: Erased, but Not Gone: Output Forgetting Is Not True Forgetting
abstract: arXiv:2606.25001v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) is commonly judged by output forgetting, such as low forget-set accuracy or reduced membership inference. But if output-level success can coexist with retraining-inconsistent residuals in representation space, what kind of forgetting are current evaluations actually certifying? We study this question through retraining-consistent representation forgetting, using a population of retrained models (i.e., trained from scratch without the forget data) as an operational reference distribution for ideal forgetting. Across multiple unlearning methods, datasets, and models, our theoretical analysis and empirical results show that standard output-level evaluation can systematically overestimate the success of unlearning. translated_title: 已被抹除，但并未消失：输出层面的遗忘并非真正的遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘（MU）通常通过输出层面的遗忘效果来评判，例如遗忘集上的低准确率或成员推断攻击效果的减弱。但如果输出层面的成功可能与表示空间中重训练不一致的残余共存，那么当前的评估究竟在认证何种意义上的“遗忘”？我们通过“重训练一致的表示遗忘”来研究这一问题，使用一组重训练模型（即从头开始训练且不包含待遗忘数据的模型）的总体作为理想遗忘的可操作参考分布。在多种遗忘方法、数据集和模型上，我们的理论分析与实证结果表明，标准的输出层面评估会系统性地高估遗忘的成功程度。在这种更严格的视角下，当前方法往往在输出层表现得像已遗忘，但在表示层面却与重训练结果存在结构性的不匹配。它们在遗忘集上仅部分对齐于重训练……
tldr: 该论文提出以重训练模型群体作为参考分布的“重训练一致的表示遗忘”评估范式，揭示现有机器遗忘方法虽在输出层面看似遗忘成功，但在表示空间中仍与理想遗忘存在结构性偏差，即输出遗忘并不等于真正的遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "retraining-consistent representation forgetting," which uses a population of retrained models as a reference distribution, revealing that current machine unlearning methods can appear forgotten at the output level while still exhibiting structured mismatches with ideal forgetting in representation space—output forgetting is not true forgetting.
